welcome.skipHint: Closes this introduction and opens the studio with the current settings
welcome.doneHint: Closes this introduction and opens the studio

language.title: Choose your language
language.body: Every menu, button and message uses this language. You can change it later in Settings.

look.title: How it looks
look.body: Dark is the studio’s own theme. Switch it if you work in daylight.
look.themeHint: Switches the application to the {{name}} theme

craft.title: Your 3D navigation
craft.body: The 3D view mirrors the gestures of the software you already know. You can change it later in the settings.
craft.navigationHint: Uses {{name}} viewport gestures in the 3D view

ai.title: AI, through every door
ai.body: The studio depends on no AI in particular: they plug in, they swap out, and they can even drive it.

local.title: On this machine
local.body: The studio downloads the weights and runs them here. Nothing leaves, nothing is billed.

ollama.title: With Ollama
ollama.body: Already installed? The studio reads your models and uses them as they are.

cloud.title: At a provider
cloud.body: One key, and generation goes out. Interchangeable: none of them is the product.

mcp.title: And the other way round
mcp.body: The studio publishes its tools: Claude Code, or any MCP agent, opens a project and generates for you.

models.title: Models, section by section
models.body: The studio downloads the weights, then runs them here. Some models require access from their publisher. The size shows the disk space needed.
models.more: The full catalogue lives in the settings.
models.motionOptional: Motion generation is optional. Install a model now, or continue and find it later in Settings → AI → 3D. Animation retargeting works without AI.

account.title: A cloud, if you have one
account.body: The studio works without an account, on your own files. A key unlocks generation and the shared library.
account.stored: These services are already saved on this machine. Add another one, or carry on.
account.addServiceHint: Opens the form to store one more key
account.adding: Paste the key of the service to store.
account.backToListHint: Drops what is typed here and shows the stored services again

project.title: Your first project
project.body: A project is a folder on your disk. Create one, open one, or skip and start from Home.
project.createHint: Picks an empty folder and makes it the project
project.openHint: Opens a project folder already on this disk
